_readme: Live pointer, read at page load. Edit on the server and refresh — no rebuild needed. There are only two sources: the roster behind rosterApiUrl for login, and the one spreadsheet in sheetId for everything a parent reads.
_rosterApiUrl: SOURCE 1 — login. /api/lookup is the Netlify function. Requires ROSTER_CSV_URL — and ADMIN_EMAILS for staff — in the SERVER environment.
_sheetId: SOURCE 2 — everything else. Share link of the single spreadsheet holding the trip content. Needs 'Anyone with the link → Viewer'. Leave blank if you are using publishedId instead.
_publishedId: SOURCE 2, the private-document route. Paste the File → Share → Publish to web link (it contains /d/e/2PACX-…). The spreadsheet itself stays Restricted; only this read-only snapshot is public. Wins over sheetId. Tabs are addressed by gid here, not by name, so put each tab's gid in 'gids' — with none set, the first tab is served.
_csvBase: Local CSV files instead of Google, for development only. Blank in production.
_gids: Only needed if a tab has been renamed — a gid survives renames and wins over the tab name.
_driveApiKey: Optional. Turns a Drive FOLDER link inside a Documents row into one card per file. Not a content source on its own.
_adminEmails: Leave empty. Staff are configured via ADMIN_EMAILS in the server environment — this file is public, and listing staff here would tell anyone which address unlocks every grade.
_googleClientId: OAuth 2.0 Web client id. When set, the login page shows Google Sign-In and One Tap signs a returning parent in with no typing.
